findings.evidence: #viewdetails-btn is a secondary button (type="button") placed among form fields at line 73, before the date-of-birth fieldset at line 74. The primary submit button is at line 189.
findings.fix: Move the View details button to the end of the form, after all required fields, and style the primary submit button more prominently, or remove the secondary action if it is not essential to the signup task.
findings.violation: A secondary action is placed above fields within the form, so a person completing the form encounters it before finishing the required date of birth fields and may mistakenly click it thinking the form is done.

findings.evidence: <select id="dob-day-select" autocomplete="bday-day" required=""> <select id="dob-month-select" autocomplete="bday-month" required=""> <select id="dob-year-select" autocomplete="bday-year" required="">
findings.fix: Use three short text fields for day, month and year, with the numeric input mode.
findings.violation: A date the person knows by heart is picked from three drop-downs, the year from 60 options.

findings.evidence: Form heading: 'Create your account'; submit label: 'Create account'; form requires postal code, street address, shipping speed, organization name, account number, membership number, legal name, and asks for full name and legal name (your name) twice.
findings.fix: Remove the delivery-related fields (postal code, street address, shipping speed, preferred contact time) and account-related fields (membership number, account number, organization name) from the signup step. Move them to a later fulfillment step. Ask for the person's name once, not twice.
findings.violation: The form asks for many fields that the account creation task does not use: delivery address, shipping speed, organization name, account and membership numbers. It also asks for the person's name twice (full name and legal name), duplicating information.

findings.evidence: <input id="postal-input" name="postal_code" type="text" autocomplete="postal-code" required="" size="3"> (size=3)
findings.fix: Size the field to show at least 5 characters.
findings.violation: This postal code field shows 3 characters, too few to show a typical value whole while it is typed and checked.

findings.fix: Loosen the pattern to accept every valid way of writing the value, and normalise it after submission.
findings.violation: The pattern on this phone field rejects valid values such as +44 20 7946 0958; 020 7946 0958.

findings.evidence: font-size: 13px declared by its inline style
findings.fix: Set the field's font size to at least 16 pixels.
findings.violation: The text in this field is 13 pixels, below the 16 pixels at which a phone stops zooming the page on focus.
This web address field is type text, so a phone does not show the keyboard built for it.

findings.evidence: #contacttime-label has inline CSS 'display:inline-block;float:left;width:140px' positioning it beside its field, while all other labels use default block layout and sit above their fields.
findings.fix: Position all labels consistently: either above all fields or beside all fields throughout the form. If above, remove the inline CSS from the contact time label. If beside, apply consistent CSS to all labels.
findings.violation: The form mixes label positions: the contact time label sits beside its field while all other labels sit above their fields, creating visual and cognitive inconsistency.
